name: Asaki, Yumemishi
source:
I'm a high school student. This summer, I'm visiting a small town in the country. The town is surrounded by mountains and people peacefully coexist with ayakashi here. I don't remember it, but I feel like there was something I cherished here. The people I spend my time with here all feel somehow important. They are Giou (an ayakashi), Shinonome, Shu, Takatora, and Chihaya.

I get involved in trouble due to an appearance of another mysterious ayakashi. Mysterious phenomena... Nightmare... I don't wanna remember that thing, but I have to... When the moon becomes full, what will happen to me...? Now, my summer starts...

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
我是一名高中生。今年夏天，我来到乡间的一座小镇。小镇群山环绕，人们在这里与妖怪和平共处。虽然没有相关记忆，我却觉得自己曾在这里珍藏过某样事物。陪伴我度过这段时光的人，也都莫名显得十分重要。他们是妖怪祇王、东云、愁、高虎和千早。

另一个神秘妖怪现身，将我卷入麻烦。神秘现象……噩梦……我不愿想起那件事，却又非想起来不可……月圆之时，我会遭遇什么……？现在，我的夏天开始了……

[摘自Himeya Shop]
